the optimal control policy for the M/M/1/K queue with impatient customers consists of two parts: (1) the control policy for the queue length and the number of customers in the system is the same as the optimal policy for the M/G/1 queue with no impatient customers, and (2) the control policy on the arrival rate of the customers is the same as that for the M/M/k queue with impatient and non impatient customers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the optimal control is to admit customers only up to the point where the queue length is equal to the system capacity.
the performance of the system under control can be significantly improved by controlling the arrival rate.
, for the M/M/1 queue with impatient customers, the optimal control policy is of the threshold type, and the optimal threshold is a function of the number of impatient customers.
